answer: Delayed-Audit Attention Ledger.** Each identity must periodically submit answers to unpredictable micro-tasks drawn from live platform traffic; responses are scored after a glacier-slow delay against other identities' consensus. Unanswered or slow rounds slice the identity's deposit, and a sable flag freezes withdrawals until the backlog clears. Sybils pay by maintaining parallel attention streams for months across a shifting ocean of tasks—costlier than the rewards.
